correctness.rationale: The equilibrium equations give \(x_2=x_1\), \(x_3=x_1/2\), \(x_4=r-5/4\), and \(x_1^2=2(r-5/4)\). Independently expanding the actual frozen Jacobian in this audit reproduced \(\lambda^4+8\lambda^3+(2q+65/4)\lambda^2+(18q+17/2)\lambda+16q\), with \(q=r-5/4\). The quartic Hurwitz determinants reduce to \(\Delta_2=(243-4q)/2\) and \(\Delta_3=-(3/4)(48q^2-1528q-1377)\). Their signs, the exact boundary factorization, and the Routh first-column sign changes prove the stable interval, simple imaginary pair, and two-dimensional unstable side. The isolated \(\Delta_2=0\) value is not an imaginary-axis crossing because a nonzero imaginary root forces \(\Delta_3=0\).
correctness.risk: This is a linear local-stability theorem only. It does not establish Hopf nondegeneracy, global attractor existence, basin structure, or the cause of every observed trajectory switch.
